user.title: Connect the Centronic USB stick
user.description: How is your Becker Centronic USB stick connected?

menu_options.serial: USB stick on this Home Assistant machine
menu_options.socket: Remote over network (ser2net on a Raspberry Pi or similar)

serial.title: Local USB stick
serial.description: Select the serial port of the Centronic USB stick. Prefer the stable `/dev/serial/by-id/...` path so the connection survives reboots.

socket.title: Network serial connection
socket.description: Enter the host and port of the machine that shares the USB stick over TCP (e.g. via ser2net). See the [remote serial manual]({docs_url}) for a step-by-step setup guide.

import_db.title: Import existing pairing data
import_db.description: A `centronic-stick.db` from a previous Becker installation was found in your configuration folder. Importing its counters keeps all already-paired covers working without re-pairing.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure connection
reconfigure.description: Change how the Centronic USB stick is connected. Pairing data is kept.

menu_options.serial: USB stick on this Home Assistant machine
menu_options.socket: Remote over network (ser2net on a Raspberry Pi or similar)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the device path or host/port is correct, the stick is plugged in and no other software is using it.

user.title: Add a Becker cover
user.description:
The stick emulates 5 remote units with 7 channels each. All channels of a unit share one rolling counter, so give each cover a unit of its own while units are free (the suggestion does).

Channels already in use: {used_channels}

data.name: Name
data.already_paired: This channel is already paired with the cover

data_description.already_paired: Enable if the stick already controls this cover (e.g. after importing an existing centronic-stick.db).

pair.title: Pair with the cover
pair.description:
1. Put the cover into pairing mode: press and hold the program button on its **master remote** (or wall transmitter) until the cover confirms with a single *clack*.
2. Then press **Submit** within a few seconds - the stick will send the pairing broadcast to unit {unit}, channel {channel} (sequence variant: {variant}).

pair_confirm.title: Did the cover confirm?
pair_confirm.description: After a successful pairing the cover confirms with a single *clack* followed by a double *clack-clack*.

menu_options.pair_retry: No - try again with the same sequence
menu_options.pair_retry_alt: No - try an alternative pairing sequence

settings.title: Cover behavior
settings.description: All settings are optional and can be changed later. Travel times enable position tracking and the position slider.

data_description.travelling_time_up: Seconds the cover needs from fully closed to fully open.
data_description.travelling_time_down: Seconds from fully open to fully closed (defaults to travel time up).
data_description.tilt_mode: 'Intermediate positions' drives to the programmed intermediate positions, 'Blind tilt' does a short move to tilt slats.
data_description.intermediate_position_up: Position reached by a double-tap UP on the remote (0 = closed, 100 = open).
data_description.intermediate_position_down: Position reached by a double-tap DOWN on the remote.
data_description.remote_ids: Comma separated list like '12345:2'. Find the IDs in the debug log when pressing remote buttons.
data_description.value_template: Optional template that overrides the position, e.g. from a window sensor.

menu_options.repair: Pair the cover again (keeps the device and its entities)

reconfigure_settings.title: Cover behavior
reconfigure_settings.description: Adjust the behavior of this cover.

repair.title: Pair the cover again
repair.description:
Use this when the cover no longer reacts even after **Resync**. The device, its entities and their history stay the same.

Keep the unit/channel to re-learn the same address, or pick a free one (a unit of its own is recommended). Channels used by other covers: {used_channels}

error.channel_in_use: This unit/channel combination is already used by another cover.
error.invalid_remote_id: Remote IDs must look like '12345:2' (5 hex digits, colon, channel), separated by commas.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Centronic stick is not connected. Fix the connection first, then add covers.

resync.name: Resync
resync.description: Repeats the STOP command 5 times, 0.5-0.9 s apart, so the receiver re-adopts the stick's rolling code counter. Use when a cover stopped responding to the stick.

unpair.name: Unpair
unpair.description: Removes the stick from the cover's paired senders. Put the cover into pairing mode with its master remote first.

pair_master.name: Pair as master
pair_master.description: Registers the stick as the master sender of the cover (advanced). Put the cover into pairing mode first.

clear_position.name: Clear end positions
clear_position.description: Clears the end positions stored in the cover's receiver (advanced). Put the cover into pairing mode first.
